function.name: screenshot
function.description: Capture a screenshot of a website with Screenshotlayer and send it on WhatsApp. Use this when the user asks how a site looks, wants a snapshot, preview, or screenshot of a URL. Always pass a full http/https URL. After the image is sent, give a short recap with the URL. Do not describe the page unless the screenshot was captured.

url.description: Website URL to capture, for example https://www.apple.com

fullpage.description: If true, capture the full page height instead of the viewport only.

viewport.description: Viewport size in pixels, for example 1440x900 or 390x844 for mobile.

width.description: Optional thumbnail width in pixels. Omit for the full viewport width.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before capture, from 1 to 20. Use for pages that load slowly.

format.description: Image format: PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, or WEBP. Default PNG.

force.description: If true, skip cache and capture a fresh screenshot. Default true.
